buyBody: The inverted mark in black on white. The highest-contrast hat we make, and the one that reads from furthest away.
pieceHeadline: The loudest quiet hat in the range
pieceParas: Black on white is the most legible combination there is, which means the upside-down mark lands from across a fairway rather than from three feet.
If you like the joke and you want people to actually get it, this is the version to take.
lifestyleBrief: Portrait 4:5, on body. Mid-distance rather than close — the point of this one is that it reads from far away, so shoot it from far away. There is no on-body hat photography at all yet (HANDOFF §7b F).
